# kvm-cli

> Agent-first CLI for the GL.iNet Comet PoE Remote KVM (GL-RM1PE) — a PiKVM-based
> remote KVM exposing a REST API, a WebSocket HID channel, and a JPEG snapshot
> endpoint. Capture screenshots, inject keyboard/mouse input, mount virtual
> media, wake machines over LAN, and control ATX power.

## Documentation

- [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md): Claude Code / agent skill — overview, auth, computer-use loop, HID notes, safety
- [skill/reference/commands.md](skill/reference/commands.md): complete command reference — every command, flag, default, and example
- [README.md](README.md): install, auth setup, usage examples, global flags
- [docs/config.md](docs/config.md): config.json schema, environment variables, credential priority chain, defaults
- [docs/ergonomics.md](docs/ergonomics.md): v0.3.0 agent ergonomics — `cua find`/`text`/`wait`, selector-mode click, `screenshot --region`/`--scale`/`--until-stable`, coordinate mapping
- VNC transport: native RFB client — `kvm-cli vnc ...` and `--vnc` on `screenshot`/`cua` (None / VNC DES / Apple-ARD auth; RAW/CopyRect/Hextile). See [skill/reference/commands.md](skill/reference/commands.md#vnc)
- RustDesk: `kvm-cli rustdesk info|id|peers|status|connect` (config/peers management + launch; drive via VNC/KVM). See [skill/reference/commands.md](skill/reference/commands.md#rustdesk)
- CUA / OmniParser: [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md#computer-use-assistance-cua--omniparser) and [skill/reference/commands.md](skill/reference/commands.md#cua-computer-use-assistance) — ground a screenshot into numbered elements, select them deterministically (`cua find --text`), or resolve an instruction to a click via the models platform

## Quick Start

- Install: `brew tap roboalchemist/tap && brew install kvm-cli (or go install github.com/roboalchemist/kvm-cli@latest)`
- Auth (any one of):
  - `export KVM_URL=... KVM_USERNAME=... KVM_PASSWORD=...`
  - gopass entries `env/GLKVM_URL`, `env/GLKVM_USERNAME`, `env/GLKVM_PASSWORD`
  - `kvm-cli config set url|username|password ...`
- Verify: `kvm-cli auth status`
- Discover: `kvm-cli --help` and `kvm-cli skill print`

## Agent Computer-Use Loop

```bash
kvm-cli screenshot -o /tmp/screen.jpg     # SEE
# THINK: analyze /tmp/screen.jpg (framebuffer 2560x1440)
kvm-cli hid mouse move 1280 720           # ACT
kvm-cli hid mouse click left
kvm-cli hid type "hello world" --enter
kvm-cli hid combo ctrl+alt+del
kvm-cli screenshot -o /tmp/screen.jpg     # SEE again
```

## CUA / OmniParser (computer-use assistance)

`kvm-cli cua` grounds a screenshot into numbered UI elements and resolves a
natural-language instruction to a click, via the models platform
(default `https://models.example.com`).

```bash
kvm-cli screenshot                        # SEE — writes a temp file in the scratch dir
kvm-cli cua ground                        # elements (auto-captures if no --image)
kvm-cli cua click "click the Settings icon"          # plan + resolve (no click)
kvm-cli cua click "click Login" --execute --yes      # actually click over HID
kvm-cli cua models                        # list grounding/chat models
kvm-cli cua probe                         # grounding readiness (alias: cua status)
kvm-cli cua parse screenshot.jpg          # Microsoft /parse/ compatibility
```

Only the grounded element list reaches the planner — image bytes are never put
in the model prompt. Screenshots default to the scratch dir (never the CWD);
`--annotate` writes the Set-of-Mark PNG on demand.

Config (flag > env > config > default): `--models-url`/`KVM_MODELS_URL`/`models_url`
(default `https://models.example.com`), `--model`/`KVM_GROUNDING_MODEL`/`grounding_model`
(default `omniparser`), `--planner`/`KVM_PLANNER_MODEL`/`planner_model` (optional; 'auto' picks a running chat model, empty = plan yourself via `cua find` + selector click),
`--scratch-dir`/`KVM_SCRATCH_DIR`/`scratch_dir` (default OS temp dir).

## Commands

- auth: `login`, `check`, `status`, `logout`
- info: device information document
- system: read info; `set-hostname`, `set-network`, `set-config`, `set-param`, `set-time`, `set-timezone`, `set-firewall`, `ssl-cert` (require `--yes`)
- screenshot: capture a JPEG (default output: scratch dir; `-o`, `--frames`, `--keep-alive`)
- streamer: `status`, `snapshot` (alias for screenshot), `set-params`
- hid: `status`, `keys`, `key`, `combo`, `type`, `print`, `mouse move|click|down|up|wheel`, `set-mouse-output`
- atx: `status`, `power` (`--long`), `reset`, `click <power|power_long|reset>` (group flag `--force`)
- cua: `models`, `probe` (alias `status`), `ground [image]`, `click INSTRUCTION`, `parse [image]` — OmniParser grounding + planner click
- msd: `status`, `partitions`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `set-connected`, `set-params`, `write`, `write-remote`, `format`, `remove`
- wol: `list`, `scan`, `add`, `wake`, `remove`
- switch: `status`, `set-active` (unsupported on this firmware)
- screen: `status`, `background`, `set-background`, `delete-background`, `set-mode`, `set-time-format`, `set-date-format`
- tailscale / netbird / zerotier: overlay-network clients (`start`, `stop --yes`, `status`, ...)
- repeater: `scan`, `status`, `saved`, `connect`, `enable`, `disconnect --yes`, `remove-saved --yes`
- ap: `status`, `enable`, `close-all`, `open-last`
- modem: `at`, `sim-setting`, `input-pin`
- upgrade: `version`, `check`, `download`, `cancel`, `edid`, `log`, `start --yes`, `upload --yes`, `reboot --yes`, `reset --yes`
- twofa (alias `2fa`): `is-enabled`, `show`, `create --yes`, `init --yes`, `delete --yes`
- asr: `status`, `start`, `stop`
- fingerbot: `battery`, `click`, `upgrade --yes`
- init: `status`, `run --yes`, `change-password --yes`
- turn: `get`
- config: `get`, `set`, `list`, `unset`
- skill: `print`, `path`, `add` · docs · man · completion · version

Destructive operations require `--yes`; without it they print a dry run.

## Output Formats

- `--json` (`-j`): machine-readable JSON (all data-returning commands)
- `--plaintext` (`-p`): tab-separated values for piping
- `--format table|json|plaintext|yaml`
- `--fields a,b`: project JSON keys (reduce tokens)
- `--jq '<expr>'`: filter JSON
- stdout = data; stderr = warnings/progress/errors
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` user/runtime error, `2` usage error

## Authentication

Priority chain per field: flags > `KVM_*` env > `GLKVM_*` env > gopass
(`env/GLKVM_*`) > config file > prompt (TTY only).

## Environment

| Variable | Alias | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `KVM_URL` | `GLKVM_URL` | KVM device base URL |
| `KVM_USERNAME` | `GLKVM_USERNAME` | Username |
| `KVM_PASSWORD` | `GLKVM_PASSWORD` | Password |
| `KVM_TIMEOUT` | `GLKVM_TIMEOUT` | HTTP timeout (Go duration, default `30s`) |
| `KVM_INSECURE` | `GLKVM_INSECURE` | Skip TLS verification (`true`/`false`) |
| `KVM_TLS_STRICT` | `GLKVM_TLS_STRICT` | Disable the insecure TLS fallback (`1`) |
| `KVM_CONFIG` | `GLKVM_CONFIG` | Config file path |
| `KVM_MODELS_URL` | — | Models platform root for `cua` (default `https://models.example.com`) |
| `KVM_GROUNDING_MODEL` | — | CUA grounding model id (default `omniparser`) |
| `KVM_PLANNER_MODEL` | — | CUA planner chat model id (optional; 'auto' = pick a running chat model) |
| `KVM_SCRATCH_DIR` | — | Scratch dir for transient screenshots/artifacts (default OS temp dir) |
| `NO_COLOR` | | Disable coloured output |

## Notes

- ATX is disabled on `glkvm` (`"enabled": false`); `atx power`/`reset` refuse unless `--force`.
- Key names are DOM `KeyboardEvent.code` values (`KeyA`, `Enter`, `ControlLeft`); run `kvm-cli hid keys`.
- Screenshots (`screenshot`, `streamer snapshot`) default to a timestamped file in the scratch dir, never the CWD; override with `--scratch-dir`/`KVM_SCRATCH_DIR`/`scratch_dir`.
- `kvm-cli cua` resolution: only the grounded element list reaches the planner — image bytes are never put in the model context.
- CUA grounding backends: `--grounding-backend platform|local` — local runs the pinned icon_detect YOLO ONNX (~12 MB) in-process via ONNX Runtime (`cua model download --yes`; CoreML/CUDA/CPU EPs; icon boxes only, no OCR).
- CUA planner: optional; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via `--planner-url`/`KVM_PLANNER_URL` (+`--planner-api-key`), or `--planner auto` for a models-platform chat model; default planner-free (agent picks via `cua find` + selector click).
- The device uses a self-signed/invalid TLS certificate; `kvm-cli` auto-falls back to insecure TLS with a warning.
- `config` file: `~/.config/kvm-cli/config.json` (mode `0600`). See [docs/config.md](docs/config.md).
